5729.title: Source server cache compiles before lookup
5729.rootCauseOneLine: The server cache unconditionally compiles and hashes output before checking for an existing artifact.
5729.proposedFix: Define dependency-aware compiler input fingerprints and check cached artifacts before compilation.
5729.caveats: Focused fresh-process cache reproduction, not a full application launch; seven-plugin startup delay not measured. Full test is inline in the report. No automatic PR: safe invalidation needs compiler/runtime cache-input design beyond the simple-fix gate.
